notSupported: instancing a whole node hierarchy of a glTF asset

rules: Floats 1.0,0.5,2.5e-3: digits around '.'; integers unsigned decimal, no leading zeros.
< <= > >= == != do not chain; use (a < b) && (b < c).
No implicit conversions; literals take expected numeric types.
compute P { param gain:f32=2.0; input src:array<T,N>; output dst:array<T,N>; kernel(i:ComputeInput)->T{return src[i.index];} } Host: app.createCompute. Fixed N; <=4 inputs, 1 output.

schemaGuide: Fields: name: type = default [flags] range R // meaning. R required; W writable; B bindable; C construction-only. Unlisted fields do not exist. [args] optional; [handler] handlers/lifecycle only.

schemas.name: Box
schemas.doc: An axis-aligned box centred on the origin.
fields: size: vec3 = vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) [C] // Full extents along X, Y and Z.

schemas.name: BoxCollider
fields: size: vec3 [RC] // Full extents along X, Y and Z.
sensor: bool = false [C] // A sensor reports collisions but pushes nothing.
friction: f32 = 0.5 [C] // Coulomb friction coefficient.
restitution: f32 = 0.0 [C] range 0…1 // Bounciness, 0 to 1.

schemas.name: Camera
schemas.doc: The fields of a `camera`. Looks along local -Z, or at `target` when declared.
fields: position: vec3 = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 5.0) [WB] // Camera position in world space, in metres.
target: vec3 [WB] // Optional point to look at (up is +Y); excludes `rotation`.
rotation: quat = quat.identity() [WB] // Orientation when no `target` is declared.
projection: projection = Perspective {} [C] // `Perspective {..}` or `Orthographic {..}`; the kind is construction-only, its fields writable and bindable.
active: bool [C] // Marks the active camera; optional with one camera, exactly one `active: true` with several.
exposure: f32 = -1.9145305 [C] // EV100; lit materials scale by 1 / (1.2 * 2^exposure). Default -log2(1.2 * pi): white under 1 lux shows white; a sunny day (about 100 000 lux) is about 15.

schemas.name: CapsuleCollider
schemas.doc: A capsule shape: a cylinder along local Y capped by hemispheres.
fields: radius: f32 [RC] // Radius in metres.
height: f32 [RC] // Full height including both caps; > 2 * `radius`.
sensor: bool = false [C] // A sensor reports collisions but pushes nothing.
friction: f32 = 0.5 [C] // Coulomb friction coefficient.
restitution: f32 = 0.0 [C] range 0…1 // Bounciness, 0 to 1.

schemas.name: DirectionalLight
schemas.doc: A light infinitely far away. Travels along the entity's world -Z axis; rotate the entity to aim it.
fields: color: color = #ffffff [WB] // Light colour (linear RGB; alpha is ignored).
intensity: f32 = 1.0 [WB] // Illuminance in lux.

schemas.name: Dynamic
schemas.doc: A solver-controlled body; forces, impulses and teleports are explicit commands.
fields: mass: f32 = 1.0 [C] // Mass in kilograms.
linear_damping: f32 = 0.0 [C] // Rate at which linear velocity decays.
angular_damping: f32 = 0.05 [C] // Rate at which angular velocity decays.
continuous: bool = false [C] // Continuous collision detection for this body.

schemas.name: Emitter
schemas.doc: A bounded particle emitter: at most 64 particles, `rate` per second, in a hemisphere around the entity's up axis.
fields: rate: f32 = 0.0 [C] // Particles spawned per second. A fraction carries to the next frame.
lifetime: f32 = 1.0 [C] // How long each particle lives, in seconds.
speed: f32 = 1.0 [C] // Initial speed in metres per second.
size: f32 = 0.05 [C] // Billboard size in metres.
gravity: f32 = 0.0 [C] // Downward acceleration in metres per second squared.

schemas.name: Entity
schemas.doc: Entity/prefab: a named transform with optional components.
fields: position: vec3 = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) [WB] // Position local to the parent, in metres.
rotation: quat = quat.identity() [WB] // Rotation local to the parent.
scale: vec3 = vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) [WB] // Parent-local scale; construction-only on bodies, `vec3(1.0)` on dynamic and kinematic ones.
visible: bool = true [WB] // Hide the mesh; behavior keeps running.
bounds_center: vec3 = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) [WB] // Final deformed local sphere center; used when bounds_radius > 0.
bounds_radius: f32 = 0.0 [WB] // Enclose every final local vertex/pose; 0 uses mesh/skin bounds, or unbounded authored vertices.
mesh: mesh [C] // The mesh drawn: a descriptor (`Box`, `Sphere`, `Plane`) or an asset mesh.
material: material = Unlit {} [W] // Material instance; a value-only one can be replaced by the same material type; params are writable and bindable. Requires `mesh`.
light: light [C] // A light (`DirectionalLight`, `PointLight`); its fields are writable and bindable. Named entities only.
body: body [C] // A physics body (`Static`, `Dynamic`, `Kinematic`). Root entities only; requires `collider`.
collider: collider [C] // A collision shape (`BoxCollider`, `SphereCollider`, `CapsuleCollider`). Requires `body`.
tag: string [C] // A group name (`"rock"`: lowercase letters, digits, `_`) for `count_tagged`, `first_tagged`, `nearest_tagged`, `tagged`, `has_tag` and `destroy_tagged`.
particles: emitter [C] // A particle emitter: up to 64 camera-facing billboards of this entity's mesh in its material's colour; counted even without a mesh.
clip: string [C] // A glTF animation name that moves this entity; the mesh must come from that file.
clips_from: glb_asset [C] // A GLB whose humanoid skeleton supplies the clips, retargeted onto this skeletal mesh; `clip` names are then that file's.

schemas.name: Kinematic
schemas.doc: Program-moved body: `set_kinematic_target`, or `move_character` with collisions. Fields tune `move_character`.
fields: max_slope: f32 = 0.7853982 [C] range 0…1.5707964 // Steepest climbable slope in radians.
step_height: f32 = 0.25 [C] // Highest step climbed in metres; 0 disables.
step_min_width: f32 = 0.1 [C] // Narrowest tread stepped onto in metres.
snap_to_ground: f32 = 0.2 [C] // Longest snap-down in metres; 0 disables.
skin: f32 = 0.01 [C] // Gap kept from contacts in metres.
carry: bool = true [C] // Moving platforms carry the character.

schemas.name: Orthographic
schemas.doc: An orthographic projection (right-handed, clip depth 0 to 1).
fields: height: f32 = 10.0 [WB] // Height of the view volume in world units; width follows the aspect ratio.
near: f32 = 0.1 [WB] // Distance to the near plane.
far: f32 = 1000.0 [WB] range > near // Distance to the far plane.

schemas.name: Pbr
schemas.doc: Metallic-roughness PBR with optional scene shadows and environment lighting.
fields: base_color: color = #ffffff [WB] // Linear base colour multiplied with the base colour texture.
metallic: f32 = 0.0 [WB] // Metalness; clamped to 0..1 by the lighting model.
roughness: f32 = 0.5 [WB] // Perceptual roughness; clamped to 0.045..1 by the lighting model.
base_color_texture: texture = texture.white() [C] // Base colour texture.
base_color_sampler: sampler = sampler.linear_repeat() [C] // Sampler for the base colour texture.
metallic_roughness_texture: texture = texture.white() [C] // Linear green roughness and blue metallic factors.
metallic_roughness_sampler: sampler = sampler.linear_repeat() [C] // Sampler of the metallic_roughness map.
normal_texture: texture = texture.white() [C] // Linear tangent-space normal map; enable with normal_scale.
normal_sampler: sampler = sampler.linear_repeat() [C] // Sampler of the normal map.
occlusion_texture: texture = texture.white() [C] // Linear red indirect-light occlusion.
occlusion_sampler: sampler = sampler.linear_repeat() [C] // Sampler of the occlusion map.
emissive_texture: texture = texture.white() [C] // sRGB emissive colour, multiplied by emissive.
emissive_sampler: sampler = sampler.linear_repeat() [C] // Sampler of the emissive map.
normal_scale: f32 = 0.0 [WB] // Normal XY scale; zero suits the white fallback. GLB map default: one.
occlusion_strength: f32 = 1.0 [WB] // Indirect-light occlusion strength, clamped to 0..1.
emissive: color = #000000 [WB] // Linear emission before exposure.

schemas.name: Perspective
schemas.doc: A perspective projection (right-handed, clip depth 0 to 1).
fields: fov_y: f32 = 0.9 [WB] range (0, π) // Full vertical field of view in radians.
near: f32 = 0.1 [WB] // Distance to the near plane.
far: f32 = 1000.0 [WB] range > near // Distance to the far plane.

schemas.name: Plane
schemas.doc: A single-sided horizontal plane at y = 0 facing +Y.
fields: size: vec2 = vec2(1.0, 1.0) [C] // Extent along X and Z.

schemas.name: PointLight
schemas.doc: A light radiating from the entity's world position.
fields: color: color = #ffffff [WB] // Light colour (linear RGB; alpha is ignored).
intensity: f32 = 1.0 [WB] // Luminous intensity in candela.
range: f32 = 0.0 [C] // Distance at which the light fades to nothing; 0 means unlimited.

schemas.name: Scene
schemas.doc: The fields of a scene: all construction-only constant expressions.
fields: clear_color: color = #000000 [C] // Colour the canvas is cleared to; only RGB is used.
ambient_color: color = #ffffff [C] // Colour of the ambient light; only RGB is used.

ambient_intensity: f32 = 0.0 [C] // Ambient light scale for lit materials; 0 is off. Multiplied by the camera's exposure scale (about 3.14 by default), so 0.3 is near full brightness on white. Unlit ignores it.
gravity: vec3 = vec3(0.0, -9.81, 0.0) [C] // Gravitational acceleration in m/s^2; used only with physics bodies.

schemas.name: Sphere
schemas.doc: A UV sphere centred on the origin.
fields: radius: f32 = 0.5 [C] // Radius in metres.
segments: u32 = 32 [C] range 3…256 // Subdivisions around the Y axis.
rings: u32 = 16 [C] range 2…256 // Subdivisions from pole to pole.

schemas.name: SphereCollider
fields: radius: f32 [RC] // Radius in metres.
sensor: bool = false [C] // A sensor reports collisions but pushes nothing.
friction: f32 = 0.5 [C] // Coulomb friction coefficient.
restitution: f32 = 0.0 [C] range 0…1 // Bounciness, 0 to 1.

schemas.name: Sprite
schemas.doc: One frame of a sprite sheet, tinted; always translucent.
fields: sheet: texture = texture.white() [C] // The sprite sheet: `columns` x `rows` equal cells.
sheet_sampler: sampler = sampler.nearest_clamp() [C] // Sampler of the sheet (default nearest, clamped).
tint: color = #ffffff [WB] // Multiplies the texel, alpha included.
cell: f32 = 0.0 [WB] // Cell (animation frame) shown, from 0, row by row; floored and wrapped, so `bind(t * fps)` animates.
columns: f32 = 1.0 [WB] range 1…64 // Cells per row of the sheet.
rows: f32 = 1.0 [WB] range 1…64 // Rows of cells in the sheet.

schemas.name: Unlit
fields: color: color = #ffffff [WB] // The colour written to the canvas.

notes: color: Linear RGBA, straight alpha; not a `vec4`. A literal `#rrggbb` is sRGB, converted; `color.linear(rgb, a)` takes linear components, `color.srgb(rgb, a)` sRGB ones. Fields `.r .g .b .a`, `.rgb`; no arithmetic.

frame: Per-frame CPU/`bind` values; route to GPU stages through material params. `update(dt)` gets the variable frame delta; `fixed_update(dt)` runs zero or more times per frame with a constant step (default 1/60 s).

diagnosticsGuide: `mtek check --format json`: code, severity, title, message, source(file,startByte,endByte,startLine,startColumn,endLine,endColumn), expected/actual, related, notes, suggestedEdits, phase. Fix errors in order; use only supplied validated edits; preserve requested features.
